description: Where the recording needs help. An empty list is a valid answer.

beatId.description: A beat id from the cue sheet.

anchor.description: action: actionLabel names a recorded action of the beat. words: fromWord and toWord index the beat's spoken words.

actionLabel.description: The recorded action label when anchor is action, otherwise empty.

fromWord.description: First spoken word index in the beat (0-based). 0 when anchor is action.

toWord.description: Last spoken word index in the beat, inclusive. 0 when anchor is action.

reason.description: pace: a fast run of actions. jargon: a term used without explanation. target: a small or low-contrast target. offscreen: something important is out of frame. wait: a long wait.

note.description: One short sentence for the reviewer.
